proof: For bottom-aligned widths10 and heights h1..h4, the external perimeter equals80+h1+h4+sum|h[i+1]-h[i]|. First heights35,60,85,110 give80+145+75=300. Second85,60,110,35 give80+120+150=350. Thus difference50cm, unique B. More generally the unknown shortest length cancels. Red steps differ by75 but outer ends differ by-25; the latter remain fully visible. Exact interval bounds use original heights, without new vertices or cut lines.
